sources.title: GitHub - mx4ai/qwen2.5: Qwen2.5 is the large language model series ...
sources.snippet: Today, we are excited to introduce the latest addition to the Qwen family: Qwen2.5. Dense, easy-to-use, decoder-only language models, available in 0.5B, 1.5B, 3B, 7B, 14B, 32B, and 72B sizes, and base and instruct variants. Pretrained on our latest large-scale dataset, encompassing up to 18T tokens.

sources.title: GitHub - QwenLM/Qwen2.5-Omni: Qwen2.5-Omni is an end-to-end multimodal ...
sources.snippet: We release Qwen2.5-Omni, the new flagship end-to-end multimodal model in the Qwen series. Designed for comprehensive multimodal perception, it seamlessly processes diverse inputs including text, images, audio, and video, while delivering real-time streaming responses through both text generation and natural speech synthesis.

sources.title: Qwen2.5-3B: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview Qwen2.5-3B is a 3.09-billion-parameter causal language model developed by Qwen that serves as a base pretrained model for text generation tasks. The model uses a transformer architecture with rotary positional embeddings (RoPE), SwiGLU activation, RMSNorm, attention QKV bias, and tied word embeddings.
